OK..cctor: 193.161.193.99 TCP port 56441, version <- NjRAT 0.7d Horror Edition ->.
kl.WRK (RVA 0x8910) polls virtual keys 0..255 with GetAsyncKeyState, appends translated keys and window context to Logs, saves registry log.
OK.Ind (RVA 0x3790), kl command branch at IL 0x186: reads kq.Logs, Base64-encodes, sends through OK.Send over client socket.
OK.RC receives length-prefixed TCP data and dispatches to Ind. Ind supports received-byte gzip decompression, WriteAllBytes then Process.Start on the same path.
MBRSlayer.Start (RVA 0x7b20) opens PhysicalDrive0 with GENERIC_ALL and writes 512 destructive boot-sector bytes. Ind dispatch exposes MBR overwrite commands.
DownloadString in OK.connect retrieves optional colon-separated C2 host/port configuration, not an encoded stage. Pastebin switch is Disabled in this build.
